# Natural closet development fixture

Original image: [Clothes hanged inside a closet.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Clothes_hanged_inside_a_closet.jpg), by mycurrency.com (Wikimedia user Mycaccount), licensed [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Downloaded unchanged through the Commons image-info API on 12 October 2026. License and original-file metadata are recorded in natural-closet.metadata.json.

SHA256: 71E077AB678B3B692E579D8CD9423D03967816E5F62919F071C0554F8B0F05D0.

This is an attributed development fixture, not CC0 and not a held-out launch benchmark. Keep its attribution/license with any redistributed copy or adaptation and identify changes. Do not include it in the production app's catalog or bundle. Client/server test normalization may resize/re-encode it and discard EXIF; any saved adaptation must preserve this provenance and license.

A naturally photographed crowded closet is useful for exposing overlap, difficult garment boundaries, low-light color ambiguity and incomplete detection. Exact visible-item ground truth needs independent annotation before model testing. Do not invent garment counts or hidden attributes from hangers, and do not call a successful schema parse full-wardrobe accuracy.
